description: He wears an opaque long teal crossed-front deel with full sleeves, patterned tan-gold woven borders and cloud/knot motifs. A cream inner collar and ornate tan patterned lower underlayer show at the neckline and lower opening. Two small gold-toned fastenings close the upper crossed front. Dark patterned sleeve layers extend at the forearms. A brown decorated belt closes at a large ornamental knotwork buckle; long brown sash ends hang with tassels and round metal fittings. Dark trousers tuck into dark brown calf-high leather boots with tan-gold shaft motifs. No headgear or weapon is visible.
